title: Whales in the desert
summary: Wadi Al-Hitan, Egypt: bones in the sand. Touch the sand and the sea that was here comes back, with the whales that swam in it.

doorway.label: Whales in the desert: the bones at Wadi Al-Hitan

whatsNew.title: Whales in the desert
whatsNew.what: The sea comes back over Wadi Al-Hitan; whales rise from their bones and swim; it ebbs, and each is left to dry into bones.
whatsNew.ask: The sea comes back, then goes
